items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: finally Betty Roche started dropping in and so she became our vocalist. She would sing with us every day.

ctx.x: This was in 19 -- around 1940, around that time, yes. It was around 1940. And we did have a little girl who used to come down and sing with us during rehearsal, her name was Betty Roche. You ever hear of her?
